finalText:
**Build is clean.** Exit 0, 8 warnings, 0 errors.

The bump changed the options shape from `retries` to `retryCount`, which crashed [`src/core/options.js:6`](src/core/options.js:6) with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined`. Fixed by reading `options.retryCount`.

A second bug then surfaced: the new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`, so [`src/net/retryPolicy.js:7`](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw on missing `backoffEnabled`. Fixed by treating `undefined` as disabled.

Remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise from the bumped deps, no action needed.
